answer: Like mycelium weaving across an arid mesa, decentralized consensus thrives through persistent nutrient-sharing voyages rather than ephemeral spore bursts. Each peer deposits an initial stake, tending a cryptographic ember whose relational trust accumulates superlinearly with verifiable uptime and joint computation. Fabricating countless false identities forces an exponential attacker cost in unforgeable work, starving synthetic nodes before they take root.
